Part B
Situation
You are Nico Lin. You are the Secretary for the Inter-School Visual Media Society. You assist Mr Ringo Chow, your school’s Audio-Visual teacher and the Vice Chair of the Inter-School Visual Media Society. The society is currently organising its annual Visual Media Festival, which will take place in June. Mr Ringo Chow has asked you to do some tasks.
You will listen to a recording of a video conference discussion between Ms Mira Ray, the Chair of the Inter-School Visual Media Society, and Ringo Chow. Take notes under the appropriate headings.
Before the recording is played, you will have five minutes to study the Question-Answer Book and the Data File to familiarise yourself with the situation and the tasks.
Complete the tasks by following the instructions in the Question-Answer Book and on the recording. You will find all the information you need in the Question-Answer Book, the Data File and on the recording. As you listen you can make notes on Page 3 of the Data File.
You now have five minutes to familiarise yourself with the Question-Answer Book and the Data File.

Hi Nico
We need to make sure we are on schedule in our preparations for our Youth by Youth Short Video Competition.
First, Maude needs to change her design for the Youth by Youth Short Video Competition poster. Can you complete the checklist that I have attached to give her feedback? Look at the minutes of the committee meeting and listen to the video conference I had with Mira. Also have a look at Maude’s poster, the FideoVerse website and the competition rules to help you.
Second, Akira Wong’s entry for the competition does not meet our rules. Can you please write her a polite email and explain why she has been rejected (e.g. length of video, content etc)? You can look at the rules for the competition, the information on her online submission form and our WhatsApp group. Make sure your email is encouraging and positive.
Finally, I want you to write an announcement to be posted on our new website about the Prize Giving Ceremony for the Youth by Youth Short Video Competition. In the announcement, mention: e Details about the ceremony (date and venue etc.) e Who the host is (including his/her career highlight) e Who the judge is e The activity that’s been chosen for the event
Read the minutes of the committee meeting along with the fact file and the SurveyApp results page. You can also listen to our video conference. Remember to make it sound exciting.
Mr Chow

Minutes of the Meeting of the Inter-School Visual Media Society Committee
Meeting of the Inter-School Visual Media Society Committee
Date: Thurs 28 March, 2019 Venue: Multi-media room, Tai Kiu Secondary School Chairperson: Ms Mira Ray In Attendance: Mr Ringo Chow (Vice Chair) Ms Alia Kapoor (Public Relations and Liaison) Apologies: Ms Maude Woo (Cinematic Consultant) Secretary: Nico Lin
Youth by Youth Short Video Competition Poster
Ms Ray told the meeting that the Tyrell Coffee House can no longer be the sponsor as they have declared bankruptcy. Fortunately, Yutani Video Games has offered to become the new sponsor for the Youth by Youth Short Video Competition. This should be changed on the poster.
Ms Kapoor said she was unhappy with the image on the poster. She felt it should be replaced because the Saint Elgin’s School Video Club uses the same image. She suggested using an image of a video camera instead. The committee agreed.
Nico to give Ms Woo feedback explaining changes to be made on poster.
Prize Giving Ceremony for the Youth by Youth Short Video Competition
Mr Chow told the committee that the voting from all participating schools for the prize giving ceremony would end on 5 April. From the vote results, Nico should select the most popular choices for:
° the prize giving ceremony host e the activity for the ceremony
Ms Ray noted that due to budget restrictions, there will be one judge only. Nico should select the cheapest judge. Nico should refer to the tabled Fact File.
Mr Chow confirmed all attendees of the ceremony will be given free gift packs. Nico to include this information in the announcement for the event.
Next meeting fixed for Tues. 9 April. Venue to be confirmed.

How to: Film & Video Competitions
Are you organizing a film or video competition? It’s difficult isn’t it? Not to worry, just follow our tips and you will be guaranteed success!
Posters e The name of your organization or society must be really big so people know who you are. After all you want to promote yourself! e The title of your video competition should always be underlined. e Make sure the website of your organization or society is on your poster. How will they find out all the details if you don’t? e Include any special requirements you have for your films or videos (e.g. how long it should be) e Have you included what your first prize will be (if you have one)? State that clearly somewhere on the poster.
